discussion.body:
Updating Runtime Stack to as follows: Split PixiJS — title, menus, overlay HUD only. Three.js — the 2.5D world. Raw Three, not R3F. Hide the Pixi canvas while it’s up. Meshy — production .objs. Not in the connected tools here yet; Imagine can still make the top/front/side plates.
World Octopath-style: real 3D, oil-paint, no world sprites. Rectangular heightmap. No spheres, island falloff, or sky dome. Characters yaw to camera. Clip table exists (idle / walk / attack); bob only until real frames.
Grid CELL = 1 = character width = one tile. MAP 256, HEIGHT 12. Everything snaps to cell centers. One blocker per cell. 4-dir steps, not analog slide. A/D = screen left/right.
New objects Def in (occupy / width / block) first. Ortho plates: top, front, side. Meshy → .obj. Load at cell center, footprint = occupy × CELL. Primitives are stand-ins with the same occupancy — replace, don’t fork.
Boot Title loads title-card PNGs only. Three.js and Act 0 art wait. New Game → Act 0 (on hold). Debug → Level −2.
